entities.summary: Münsterschwarzach Abbey, is a monastery of Benedictine monks in Germany. The abbey belongs to the Congregation of Saint Ottilien and is located in Schwarzach am Main, a small market town at the confluence of the rivers Schwarzach and Main in north-western Bavaria. Münsterschwarzach Abbey is a abbey in Münsterschwarzach, established in 701 CE. Relevant to cause-and-effect analysis.
